law: AMENDMENT 2 to experiments/pre_registration.json — E-Q6 (slot-collision cooker). Committed BEFORE ANY RUN of E-Q6 (pricing-first law: git history must show this commit before the result commit). Nothing here edits any E-Q1/E-Q2/E-Q5 floor. E-Q6 prices DeepSeek review finding R3 (LWW slot semantics undefined — guest_rows.jsonl call 3-R3-slot-collision-lww) via the RECOMMENDED situation 12 (slot-collision-cooker, situations/situations.jsonl call_n 12, selected by situations/selection.json under criteria CR1-CR3).

source_situation_verbatim.metric_verbatim: Twin-resonance survival rate = (total twin-resonance firings) / (total write attempts = 64 cells x 64 ticks = 4096), plus count of distinct cells that ever fired (0..64).
source_situation_verbatim.floor_verbatim: Pre-registered falsifiable prediction: with 64-way contention and left-to-right last-writer-wins, distinct cells that ever fire twin resonance is exactly 0 (the writer never reads a DIFFERENT occupant, since it overwrites then reads its own cell), so survival rate <= 0.0156 (1/64). If any distinct-cell firing is observed, M4's last-writer-wins is misimplemented.
source_situation_verbatim.tiebreak_verbatim: Tie-break for last-writer-wins is column index order left-to-right, so cell x=63 always wins slot 0 on any tick it writes.
source_situation_verbatim.task_verbatim: Over exactly 64 ticks, record for each tick which cell occupied slot 0 (the writer) and which cell read a DIFFERENT nonzero-resonance occupant (the twin-resonance firer). Accumulate: total twin-resonance firings, distinct cells that ever fired, and the imaginary-channel magnitude summed across ticks.

registered_configuration.substrate: 64x1 (w=64, h=1), ALL cells tau=3 (Abstain), d=0 (packed byte 192), via makeSubstrate + seedFn — the REAL kernel's write path, no mocks
registered_configuration.seed_note: recorded for situation fidelity; the kernel's tick() draws NO randomness (determinism contract), so the seed is inert for dynamics — the determinism floor EQ6-D1 is what makes reruns comparable
registered_configuration.firing_definition: a twin-resonance FIRING is one event {kind:'twin', x, y, slot, resonance, term} on the kernel's event stream (cells.lastEvents); a distinct FIRER is a distinct (x,y) cell emitting >= 1 such event over the 64-tick run
registered_configuration.occupancy_definition: the occupant of a slot is read from the kernel's WormholeTable snapshot after each tick (sx/sy/sr/occupied)

floors_frozen.EQ6_P1_point_prediction: REGISTERED EXACTLY AS THE GUEST SEALED IT: distinct cells that ever fire twin resonance is EXACTLY 0 over the 64-tick cooker run (guest's model: each writer overwrites then reads its own cell, so it never reads a DIFFERENT occupant).
floors_frozen.EQ6_P2_corollary_bound: REGISTERED EXACTLY AS THE GUEST SEALED IT: survival rate = total firings / 4096 <= 0.0156 (1/64).
floors_frozen.EQ6_P3_falsifier: REGISTERED EXACTLY AS THE GUEST SEALED IT: if ANY distinct-cell firing is observed, the registered last-writer-wins model is falsified (guest's words: 'M4's last-writer-wins is misimplemented'). Adjudication note frozen NOW, pre-run: the falsifier's scope is the GUEST'S MODEL of the kernel (batch write-then-read / read-own-write). The alternative model already on the record BEFORE this amendment — qthe.mjs interpretation receipts R2/R4 (commit 492333e): 'the wormhole table is read LIVE in row-major cell order' + 'WRITES collide last-writer-wins per slot, but live reads keep same-slot twins mutually audible' — predicts firings WITHOUT being a misimplementation. The experiment therefore adjudicates BETWEEN REGISTERED MODELS; whichever way the data falls, it stands. If the guest's point prediction holds, that is a crown-jewel-class honest confirmation of read-own-write semantics; if any firing is observed, R3 is answered by naming the kernel's ACTUAL deterministic collision semantics (see EQ6_A1).
floors_frozen.EQ6_D1_determinism_lane_floor: LANE-ADDED FLOOR: every arm runs TWICE from fresh construction (same seed); the two runs must be byte-identical across (a) the full checkpoint plane-hash sequence, (b) the full event-sequence hash (sha256 over the canonical JSON of every event in tick order), and (c) the final WormholeTable snapshot hash. ANY mismatch => E-Q6 VOID (loud) => collision semantics genuinely order-dependent => that outcome itself is the CONFIRMED-CRITICAL receipt for R3.
floors_frozen.EQ6_A1_semantics_adjudication_rule: LANE-ADDED, SEALED PRE-RUN: from the probe arms below, name the kernel's de-facto collision semantics EXACTLY as one of: (S1) read-own-write (guest model: no same-slot cross-writer audibility within a tick), (S2) batch-LWW (all writes land, then reads see only the final occupant), (S3) LIVE-READ ROW-MAJOR LWW (per cell, in row-major order: read current occupant, then write self — each writer audibly hears its most recent PRIOR same-tick same-slot writer, or the previous tick's occupant if none has written yet this tick; occupancy LWW by row-major order), (S4) lowest-index-wins, or (S5) undefined/order-dependent (only if EQ6-D1 fails). The rule named must reproduce EVERY probe observation; if two rules tie on all probes, report the tie honestly and R3's answer is 'deterministic under the kernel's fixed row-major order, rule not uniquely identified by these probes'.

probe_arms_and_sealed_predictions.ARM_COOK: situation 12 verbatim: 64x1 all-Abstain d=0, wormholes ON, T=64, seed 1337. Metrics: total firings, distinct firers, survival rate (string, never hashed), per-tick firing counts, per-tick contested-slot occupants, per-cell fire counts, d-trajectory min/mean/max at checkpoints [0,1,2,4,8,16,32,64], final plane hash. Under S1 (guest model): distinct firers = 0, survival rate 0. Under S2 (batch): a dying cascade — t1 = 63 firings (all but x=63 read the final occupant (63)), t2 = 62, t3 = 61, ...; distinct firers = 63 (x=63 never fires — it only ever reads its own write); survival rate ~ (63+62+...+1)/4096 ~ 0.5. Under S3 (live): every cell fires except on the tick it is FIRST to arrive at a fresh frontier slot (its read hits an empty slot); expected distinct firers = 64, survival rate just under 1.
probe_arms_and_sealed_predictions.ARM_TWO: two-writer occupancy probe: 64x1, Abstain ONLY at x=10 and x=20 (packed 192), rest Ground(0); T=8; wormholes ON. Sealed predictions per model: S1: 0 firings ever; slot-0 occupant after t1 = (20,0). S2 (batch): exactly 1 firing EVER (x=10 at t1, reading the final t1 occupant (20); every read at t2+ hits the cell's own write) — total firings = 1. S3 (live): t1 = 1 firing and it is the LATER column (x=20 reads x=10's write; x=10 read an empty slot); t2 = 1 firing and it is the EARLIER column (x=10 reads the previous-tick occupant (20) of slot 0; x=20 — d=1 after t1 — is first to arrive at empty slot 1); t3 = 2 firings (both read slot 1: x=10 sees previous-tick (20), x=20 sees x=10's same-tick write); from t4 on the pair leapfrogs up the d ladder with exactly one silent cell per tick (the first arrival at the fresh frontier slot). Distinct firers = 2. S4 (lowest-index-wins): t1 occupant = (10,0) — distinguishable from S2/S3 by occupancy alone.
probe_arms_and_sealed_predictions.ARM_CULLED: the guest's R3 culling claim made physical: THREE writers on one slot: Abstain at x=5, x=15, x=25, rest Ground; T=8. Sealed predictions: S1: 0 firings ever. S2 (batch): t1 = 2 firings (x=5, x=15 read the final occupant (25)); t2 = 1 firing (x=5 reads slot-1 final occupant (15)); t3+ = 0 (every read hits own write) — total firings = 3, the cascade DIES. S3 (live): t1 = 2 firings (x=15 reads x=5's write; x=25 reads x=15's write — the guest's 'first N-1 writers are culled' is FALSE under S3: 2 of 3 writers are heard); t2 = 2 firings (x=5 reads previous-tick occupant (25) of slot 0; x=25 reads x=15's same-tick slot-1 write; x=15 is the silent frontier arrival); t3+ = 2-3 firings per tick — the cascade does NOT die, the writers leapfrog up the d ladder. The t3+ discriminator (S2: 0 vs S3: >=2) uniquely separates batch from live.
probe_arms_and_sealed_predictions.ARM_MIRROR: order-equivalence probe: same two writers mirrored: Abstain at x=43 and x=53 (63-x image of {20,10}), rest Ground; T=8. Sealed prediction (ALL position-respecting models S1-S4): the event/occupancy structure is the exact mirror of ARM_TWO (relabel x -> 63-x, sigma and resonance values identical since acc=0 everywhere). If ARM_MIRROR diverges structurally from the mirrored ARM_TWO, the semantics has a hidden positional asymmetry => receipted as a finding and R3 escalates.
probe_arms_and_sealed_predictions.ARM_API: supplementary API-level probe (clearly NOT the dynamics path): direct WormholeTable write(slot,...) x3 in stated call order then read() — names the API's own collision rule (expected: last CALL wins, LWW by call order) so the dynamics answer (ARM_*) and the API answer are separately receipted. No claim priced on this arm alone.

lane_expectation_sealed_before_runs: LANE HONEST EXPECTATION (priced pre-run, on the record because the kernel's R2/R4 receipts are public in qthe.mjs at 492333e): I expect S3 to be selected by the probes and the guest's EQ6-P1 point prediction (0 distinct firers) to be FALSIFIED — the kernel's live-read row-major interleave makes same-slot writers audibly overlap (that is the documented mechanism C2's E-Q1 win rode on: bridges at tick 1). If instead the cooker shows 0 distinct firers, the receipts were wrong about the kernel and the autopsy follows the real coupling. Whichever way it falls, it stands.
kernel_contact_rules: CR3 honored: the cooker runs the reference kernel AS SPECDED — tick(), WormholeTable, makeSubstrate, mulberry32 only; NO new primitives, NO mocks, NO patched table

DEVIATION RECEIPTED PRE-RUN: the situation's 'Resonance seeds are distinct per cell: resonance(x)=x+1 at placement' is NOT implementable on the kernel as-specded — the kernel computes resonance at WRITE time as |real_acc|+1 (qthe.mjs item 5); no per-cell resonance seeding primitive exists and CR3 forbids adding one. On this substrate every cell's real_acc = 0 (all neighbors Abstain/Ground contribute nothing to the real channel), so every written resonance is 1. The guest's EQ6-P1 prediction does not depend on resonance values under its own model (the own-write guard blocks regardless), so the floor is frozen verbatim-faithful with this deviation receipted beside it

h=1 toroidal note (pre-run observation, receipted so the autopsy is not blamed later): on a 64x1 substrate the Moore-8 neighborhood of every cell includes the cell ITSELF twice (yUp == y == yDn); harmless here because Abstain/Ground contribute 0 to the real accumulator, but it is a real kernel-behavior fact on degenerate heights
wormhole flag: ON for all arms (the system under test IS the table); no OFF arm needed — the cooker's control is the probe arms' structure
